channel.title: Kling AI Release Notes
channel.description: Latest release notes and updates from Kling AI

item.title: Kling 3.0 Model Series Upgrade
item.description: Kling 3.0 Model Series Upgrade • Kling 3.0 Turbo is now live, along with upgraded video editing in Kling 3.0 Omni.

item.title: Cinema-Grade Native 4K, Now on Kling AI!
item.description: Cinema-Grade Native 4K, Now on Kling AI! • The world's first AI video model with native 4K output - Kling AI ushers in the era of production-ready videos.

item.title: Kling AI Team Features Now Available! Usher in the Efficient Co-Creation Era.
item.description: Kling AI Team Features Now Available! Usher in the Efficient Co-Creation Era. • One-Click Asset Sharing, Role-Specific Permission Management, and the All-New Desktop App - Launched Together! Let Inspiration and Creativity Flow Seamlessly Within the Team.

item.title: ⭐ Major
item.description: ⭐ Major • Kling VIDEO 3.0 Motion Control: Major Launch! - Professional Motion Capture, Reimagined. • Upgraded Motion Capture, High Facial Consistency

item.title: ⭐ Major
item.description: ⭐ Major • KlingAI Enters the 3.0 Era: All in One, One for All! Kling 3.0 Model Now Fully Rolled Out. • Kling 3.0 Model Now Fully Rolled Out, Setting a New Benchmark in AI Storytelling. Everyone a Director. It’s Time.

item.title: Creation Experience Upgraded - Now Supports Frame Extraction and .mov Format Export!
item.description: Creation Experience Upgraded - Now Supports Frame Extraction and .mov Format Export! • Now supports extracting keyframes from videos as the start & end frames for generation, with newly added .mov format lossless export.

item.title: ⭐ Agent
item.description: ⭐ Agent • Kling Canvas Agent officially launched! One-click Storyboard, Effortless Video Creation • The groundbreaking Kling Canvas Agent is now available! With Smart Multi-Shot and Multi-angle Expansion, short film creation is a breeze. Multi-round dialogue editing and one-click batch generation will skyrocket your creative efficiency!

item.title: Kling IMAGE O1 Model: Text-to-Image Fully Upgraded, with Enhanced Consistency in Generating Images from References!
item.description: Kling IMAGE O1 Model: Text-to-Image Fully Upgraded, with Enhanced Consistency in Generating Images from References! • Kling IMAGE O1 Model has been fully updated with excellent Text-to-Image tonal quality and overall enhanced image quality, with significant improvement in reference image consistency for Image-to-Image scenarios.

item.title: Kling VIDEO 2.6 Motion Control — Copy Any Action, Recreate Every Expression.
item.description: Kling VIDEO 2.6 Motion Control — Copy Any Action, Recreate Every Expression. • All-New Motion Control Unleashed — 30 seconds of high-difficulty action in one seamless take, with total command over movement, expressions, lip-sync, and gestures.
